movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: RoundCube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the handling of SVG animate attributes that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Roundcube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Roundcube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to manipulate data via a malicious XML attachment.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Service Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Service contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows a local attacker with user permissions to gain SYSTEM privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft DWM Core Library Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft DWM Core Library contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows an attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SmartScreen Prompt Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft SmartScreen Prompt contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that allows an attacker to bypass the Mark of the Web (MotW) feature. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-38831 and CVE-2024-21412 to execute a malicious file.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service when configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS ImageIO Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in ImageIO when processing a maliciously crafted image, which may lead to code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2023-41061.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that enables an authenticated administrator to perform malicious file writes to the EPMM server. This vulnerability can be used in conjunction with CVE-2023-35078 to bypass authentication and ACLs restrictions (if applicable).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The GPCIDrv and GDrv low-level drivers in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II expose functionality to read and write arbitrary physical memory. This could be leveraged by a local attacker to elevate privileges.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: GIGABYTE Multiple Products Unspecified Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The GDrv low-level driver in GIGABYTE App Center, AORUS Graphics Engine, XTREME Gaming Engine, and OC GURU II exposes ring0 memcpy-like functionality that could allow a local attacker to take complete control of the affected system.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Linux kernel fails to check all 64 bits of attr.config passed by user space, resulting to out-of-bounds access of the perf_swevent_enabled array in sw_perf_event_destroy(). Explotation allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiADC contain an improper access control vulnerability that allows attackers to obtain the LDAP server login credentials configured in FortiGate by pointing a LDAP server connectivity test request to a rogue LDAP server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Runtime Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Runtime contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Object Record Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains an object record corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Excel file with a malformed record object.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to gain privileges via a crafted web site.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft IME Japanese Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Input Method Editor (IME) Japanese is a keyboard with Japanese characters that can be enabled on Windows systems as it is included by default (with the default set as disabled). IME Japanese contains an unspecified vulnerability when IMJPDCT.EXE (IME for Japanese) is installed which allows attackers to bypass a sandbox and perform privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Extensions Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows AppX Deployment Extensions improperly performs privilege management, resulting in access to system files.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows CLFS Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: QNAP Network-Attached Storage (NAS) Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: QNAP NAS devices contain a command injection vulnerability which could allow attackers to perform remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft DirectX Graphics Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when the DirectX Graphics Kernel (DXGKRNL) driver improperly handles objects in memory.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft DirectX Graphics Kernel Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when the DirectX Graphics Kernel (DXGKRNL) driver improperly handles objects in memory.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Word Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Word allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via crafted RTF data.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Scripting Engine Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the scripting engine handles objects in memory in Internet Explorer.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows Error Reporting manager improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could overwrite a targeted file leading to an elevated status.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Task Scheduler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in the way the Task Scheduler Service validates certain file operations.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows AppX Deployment Service (AppXSVC) Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows AppXSVC improperly handles hard links. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when Windows improperly handles authentication requests. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run processes in an elevated context.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Software SNMP Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: The Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) subsystem of Cisco IOS and IOS XE contains a vulnerability that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to remotely execute code.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Office Memory Corruption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Office contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted document.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Accellion FTA OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a local web service call.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS Default Configuration Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS contains a default configuration vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker on the same subnet to intercept sensitive information by impersonating the Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) server.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation via a crafted application

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Kernel Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for information disclosure. Successful exploitation allows attackers to read the contents of kernel memory from a user-mode process.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Win32k fails to properly handle objects in memory causing privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Win32k contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the component failing to properly handle objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) Driver Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mozilla Firefox And Thunderbird Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability due to incorrect alias information in the IonMonkey JIT compiler when setting array elements.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall Email Security Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall Email Security contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to upload a file to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Social Warfare Plugin Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

movers24h.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: iCagenda Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: iCagenda contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows the upload of arbitrary files in the file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows specially crafted POST requests using the Content-Encoding: deflate header to crash the Serv-U service without authentication.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: Mirasvit Full Page Cache Warmer contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

movers24h.vulnerabilityName: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers24h.shortDescription: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin contains privilege escalation vulnerability that is exposed via the user-end cPanel plugin, which can be abused by any cPanel user account to execute arbitrary scripts with root privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

movers7d.product: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Use-After-Free Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Vite Vitejs Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Vite Vitejs contains an improper access control vulnerability that exposes content of non-allowed files using ?inline&import or ?raw?import. Only apps explicitly exposing the Vite dev server to the network (using --host or server.host config option) are affected.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: N-able N-Central Insecure Deserialization Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: N-able N-Central contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that could lead to command execution.

movers7d.product: Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS)
movers7d.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Privileged Remote Access (PRA) and Remote Support (RS) contain an OS command injection vulnerability that can be exploited by an attacker with existing administrative privileges to upload a malicious file. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can allow a remote attacker to execute underlying operating system commands within the context of the site user.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Google Chromium contains a type confusion vulnerability in the V8 JavaScript and WebAssembly engine.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Commvault Web Server Unspecified Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Commvault Web Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to create and execute webshells.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Microsoft Exchange Server. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could attempt to impersonate any other user of the Exchange server.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco IOS and IOS XE Group Encrypted Transport VPN Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco IOS and IOS XE contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Group Encrypted Transport VPN (GET VPN) feature that could allow an authenticated, remote attacker who has administrative control of either a group member or a key server to execute malicious code or cause a device to crash.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: TerraMaster OS Remote Command Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: TerraMaster OS contains a remote command execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to execute commands on the target endpoint.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: WebRTC Heap Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: WebRTC, an open-source project providing web browsers with real-time communication, contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform shellcode execution. This vulnerability impacts web browsers using WebRTC including but not limited to Google Chrome.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Silverlight Runtime Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Silverlight mishandles negative offsets during decoding, which allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS).

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Silverlight Double Dereference Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Silverlight does not properly validate pointers during HTML object rendering, which allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Silverlight application.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows COM Aggregate Marshaler allows for privilege escalation when an attacker runs a specially crafted application.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Unspecified vulnerability allows for an authenticated user to escalate privileges.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Win32k kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory which allows for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Win32k contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Ajax.NET Professional Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Ajax.NET Professional (AjaxPro) contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution via arbitrary .NET classes. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiSandbox OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiSandbox contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted HTTP requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Splunk Enterprise Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Splunk Enterprise contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated user to create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Marimo Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Marimo contains an pre-authorization remote code execution vulnerability, allowing an unauthenticated attacked to shell access and execute arbitrary system commands.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiClient EMS Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiClient EMS contains an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via crafted requests.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the web-based management interface that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary Java code as root on an affected device.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability if WebEx zimlet installed and zimlet JSP is enabled.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: React Native Community CLI OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: React Native Community CLI contains an OS command injection vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated network attackers to send POST requests to the Metro Development Server and run arbitrary executables via a vulnerable endpoint exposed by the server. On Windows, attackers can also execute arbitrary shell commands with fully controlled arguments.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Code Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker with Site Owner privileges to execute code remotely.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Veeam Backup & Replication Cloud Connect component contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user operating within the backup infrastructure network perimeter to obtain encrypted credentials stored in the configuration database. This may lead to an attacker gaining access to the backup infrastructure hosts.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiVoice Connect Data Validation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: The Service Appliance component in Mitel MiVoice Connect allows remote code execution due to incorrect data validation.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Confluence Server Pre-Authorization Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Affected versions of Atlassian Confluence Server allow remote attackers to view restricted resources via a pre-authorization arbitrary file read vulnerability in the /s/ endpoint.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Citrix ShareFile Improper Access Control Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Improper Access Control in Citrix ShareFile storage zones controller may allow an unauthenticated attacker to remotely compromise the storage zones controller.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Adobe BlazeDS Information Disclosure Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Adobe BlazeDS, which is utilized in LifeCycle and Coldfusion, contains a vulnerability that allows for information disclosure.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Type Confusion Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the scripting engine handles objects in memory in Internet Explorer

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: VMware Server Side Request Forgery in vRealize Operations Manager API
movers7d.shortDescription: Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in vRealize Operations Manager API prior to 8.4 may allow a malicious actor with network access to the vRealize Operations Manager API to perform a SSRF attack to steal administrative credentials.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Windows when the Win32k component fails to properly handle objects in memory, aka 'Win32k EoP.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy Improper Authorization
movers7d.shortDescription: An Improper Authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy under SSL VPN web portal allows an unauthenticated attacker to modify the password.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Accellion FTA OS Command Injection Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Accellion FTA contains an OS command injection vulnerability exploited via a crafted POST request to various admin endpoints.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Group Policy Preferences Password Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Active Directory contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it distributes passwords that are configured using Group Policy preferences. An authenticated attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could decrypt the passwords and use them to elevate privileges on the domain.

movers7d.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Netlogon Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
movers7d.shortDescription: Microsoft's Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run a specially crafted application on a device on the network. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of Zerologon.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

newest.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

newest.product: Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software
newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software Unchecked Return Value to NULL Pointer Dereference Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Improper Neutralization of Encoded URI Schemes in a Web Page Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains an improper neutralization of encoded URI schemes in a web page vulnerability that could allow an attacker to call other plugins' functions and supply their own parameters. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability which could allow an attacker using any X-Plex-Token value to include a full URL in the 'protocol' parameter and force the Plex server to POST to the attacker's chosen destination. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96654, CVE-2026-96655, and CVE-2026-96656.

newest.vulnerabilityName: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Atlassian Multiple Products Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Multiple Atlassian products (Bitbucket Data Center ,Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye) contain a files or directories accessible to external parties vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ahsay AhsayCBS Improper Authentication Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication via manipulation of the random parameter in the API component’s checkSysPwd function. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105134.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Shell contains a command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

newest.vulnerabilityName: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

newest.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

newest.vulnerabilityName: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

newest.vulnerabilityName: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

newest.vulnerabilityName: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
newest.shortDescription: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.
